reviews.shade: UNOVE Water Essence Mist 200ml Special Set (+30ml)
reviews.text:
Lo eh estado utilizando la verdad me gusta que me deja el cabello suave y cuando me lo plancho me queda muy brilloso e hidratado.
Compré el set de viaje y cuando lo utilice me enamoré de él lo mando a comprar ya en presentación full zize
reviews.zh:
我一直有用，老實講，我好鍾意佢令我頭髮軟身，而且我拉直頭髮之後，頭髮會好有光澤、好滋潤。
我先買咗旅行裝，用咗之後我好鍾意，所以而家叫咗正裝嚟買。

reviews.shade: UNOVE Water Essence Mist 200ml Special Set (+30ml)
reviews.text:
thought it was a face mist at first 💀 didn’t irritate my skin on face so don’t worry if it gets there… scent is rather strong, it smells like jasmine. haven’t seen any effect on my hair (but it sure moisturized my face lmao) since i went for the scent. isn’t heavy or oily at all
small packaging is nice to take when going out
reviews.zh:
我起初以為係面部噴霧 💀 噴到面都冇令我皮膚不適，所以如果噴到面，都唔使擔心……味道幾濃，聞落似茉莉花。我冇見到對頭髮有咩效果（但係面就真係好滋潤 lmao），因為我主要係為咗個味道先買。佢唔會好重，亦都完全唔油膩。
細樽裝外出帶住好方便。

reviews.shade: UNOVE Water Essence Mist 200ml Special Set (+30ml)
reviews.text: I love everything by unove, leaves my hair soft and shiny and I love the perfume of the products. The mist is a nice touch when I want my hair scent to last longer. And it helps at the end of the process after styling to leave the hair a little less stuck in place and softer and more natural looking. I got curly hair
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意 UNOVE 嘅所有嘢，令頭髮軟身又有光澤，而且我好鍾意產品嘅香味。當我想頭髮香味留得耐啲，呢款髮霧就好有幫助。另外，整完頭髮之後，用佢嚟收尾都好有用，可以令頭髮唔會咁硬、咁定型，而且更加柔軟，睇落更自然。我嘅頭髮係卷髮。

reviews.shade: UNOVE Water Essence Mist 200ml Special Set (+30ml)
reviews.text: I have thin and damaged hair. In my dry hair I don't find it does a lot. I do like using it in my wet hair at the top where I can't apply oil without my hair becoming greasy. I find it gives greater shine and smoother appearance there. I think Unove's hair oil is the better care product, however.
reviews.zh: 我頭髮幼細又受損。喺乾頭髮上用，我覺得冇乜效果。不過我好鍾意喺頂部濕頭髮嗰度用，因為嗰度如果用髮油，頭髮會好油膩。我覺得喺嗰度用，會有更加亮澤同更順滑嘅效果。不過，我覺得 UNOVE 嘅髮油係更好嘅護理產品。

reviews.shade: UNOVE Water Essence Mist 200ml Special Set (+30ml)
reviews.text: I had high hopes for this because I really love the original. This is a lot thinner in texture and doesn't give your hair too much of a shine nor does it hydrate as much. So if you have oily hair or thicker hair this might work better for you. Because I have thinner fragile hair the original one works better for me.
reviews.zh: 我對呢款抱住好大期望，因為我真係好鍾意原版。呢款質地稀好多，唔會令頭髮好有光澤，保濕效果都冇咁好。所以如果你頭髮出油或者髮質比較粗，呢款可能會更啱你。我嘅頭髮幼細又脆弱，所以原版對我嚟講效果更好。

reviews.shade: UNOVE Water Essence Mist 200ml Special Set (+30ml)
reviews.text: I think this product does its job, but it's not a product that I think you absolutely NEED. It's moisturizing for a few minutes but the feeling quickly goes away. I think there are other hair essences that would work better than this.
reviews.zh: 我覺得呢款產品有達到佢嘅功效，但係我覺得唔係一定要買嘅產品。保濕效果只係持續幾分鐘，感覺好快就冇咗。我覺得有其他髮精華會比呢款更好。

reviews.shade: UNOVE Water Essence Mist 200ml Special Set (+30ml)
reviews.text: After finishing the product It does help with softening the hair in morning, but it has a really strong perfume scent that might be a bit strong for most people, the scent does fade away after a bit though, but it will linger in your hair.
reviews.zh: 用完呢款產品之後，早上確實有幫助令頭髮變軟，但係佢嘅香味好濃，對大部分人嚟講可能有啲太濃。不過味道過一陣會散走，但係會留喺頭髮上。

reviews.shade: UNOVE Water Essence Mist 200ml Special Set (+30ml)
reviews.text: Love the entire Unove line. When I saw this come out, I had to try it. Like the rest of the Unove products, it has a wonderful scent! I couldn't really tell if made a difference in hair texture, but it did not leave my hair oily after applying it to dry hair.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意整個 UNOVE 系列。見到呢款推出嗰陣，我一定要試吓。好似 UNOVE 其他產品一樣，佢嘅味道都好好聞！我真係睇唔出對髮質有冇改變，但係喺乾頭髮上噴咗之後，頭髮冇變得油膩。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
